description_en: Queries the list of created image repair tasks
description_zh: 查询已创建的镜像修复任务的列表
name: DescribeImageFixTask

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the repair task that you want to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的修复任务开始的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the repair task that you want to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的修复任务结束的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the image repair task that you want to query. Valid values:

1: Repairing
2: Repaired
3: Repair failed
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的镜像修复任务的状态。取值：

1：修复中
2：修复成功
3：修复失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the results start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 20, which indicates that up to 20 entries are returned per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页中显示的修复任务的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条修复任务
parameters.name: page_size
